From the silk city of Kanchipuram

Kanchipuram — the temple city on the banks of the Palar — has woven silk for centuries. Every Murugan Trendz saree carries that same tradition: pure mulberry silk threads and gold zari, woven on the pit loom using the Korvai technique that joins body and border so strongly that the saree itself will wear out before the border does.

We work directly with weaving families around Kanchipuram, so what you see in our showroom is what came off the loom — no shortcuts, no machine substitutes.

"A saree that is worn once for a wedding, and kept for a lifetime after."
